display_information.name: RunVouch
display_information.description: Alerts when a scheduled job or AI agent is missed, fails, produces nothing, loops or overspends.
display_information.long_description: RunVouch is a dead man's switch, evidence check and cost cap for scheduled jobs and AI agents: cron, Kubernetes CronJobs, GitHub Actions, Vercel cron, Airflow, n8n, Claude Code routines, OpenClaw and 40 more runtimes. Each run reports a start and an end with evidence (a file written, a URL live, rows inserted). RunVouch watches from outside and posts to your Slack channel when a run is MISSED (the schedule stopped), FAILED (with the stderr excerpt), NO_EVIDENCE (green run, nothing produced), STALLED, RETRY_STORM (the same tool called with the same input many times), BUDGET_RUN or BUDGET_DAY (cost cap crossed, agent paused) or DRIFT (duration or output size far off its baseline). A weekly digest per workspace summarises every agent. Free for 3 agents, no card. Setup takes two minutes: add RunVouch to a channel, paste the webhook into your RunVouch settings, done.
